title: General Issues and Limitations of the JSON UI Module System
introduction: This document describes general architectural and technical limitations inherent in the current implementation of the JSON UI module system.

issues.title: Data Addressing System
issues.description: The current system uses string prefixes (`session:`, `state:`, `buffer:`, `model:`) for data access. This can lead to typing issues and potential name conflicts.
manifestations: Lack of strict type checking when accessing data.
Possibility of accidental data overwrites when using identical keys in different storages.
relatedDocuments: *Link to Core/AiRudeDepot documentation describing data storages (if exists).*
improvementPlan: Development of a typed addressing system.
Implementation of mechanisms to prevent name conflicts.

issues.title: Event System
issues.description: The current event system (`customHooks` and `hub.notifyManager`) is decentralized and lacks a unified bus.
manifestations: Difficulties in debugging the flow of events between modules.
Lack of built-in filtering or prioritization mechanisms.
relatedDocuments: *Examples of `customHooks` use in [PrimeVue in JSON UI](./primevue-components.md)*
improvementPlan: Consider implementing a unified event bus.
Add tools for monitoring and debugging events.

issues.title: Actions Structure Migration
issues.description: A transition is underway from the old action structure to a new one using `batch`. Both approaches may be present in the code.
relatedDocuments: *Link to Core/ActionExecutor or similar documentation describing action formats (if exists).*
improvementPlan: Complete migration to the new `batch` format.
Clear documentation of the new action format.

issues.title: Integration with PrimeVue
issues.description: Integrating complex PrimeVue components via the JSON structure has limitations.
manifestations: Issues with two-way `model` binding for some components (TreeTable, Calendar) - requires using `customHooks`.
Limited support for complex events (e.g., drag-and-drop).
improvementPlan: Develop adapters for more complex components.
Improve documentation on integrating specific PrimeVue components.

issues.title: Performance with Large Data
issues.description: Displaying and processing large JSON structures or data lists can impact performance.
manifestations: Delays when rendering tables/lists with thousands of elements.
improvementPlan: Active use of pagination (`paginator: true`) and virtual scrolling (where supported).
Optimization of the server-side to return only necessary data.

issues.title: Data Validation
issues.description: The current validation system is primarily implemented on the server-side (in PHP commands).
manifestations: Need for explicit implementation of validation rules in PHP.
relatedDocuments: *Link to Core/Validation documentation or PHP command examples (if exists).*
improvementPlan: Consider possibilities for declarative validation in JSON.
Improve feedback on validation errors in the UI.

issues.title: Documentation
issues.description: Documentation is undergoing continuous improvement and restructuring.
manifestations: Possible incomplete sections or outdated information.
improvementPlan: Execution of tasks from the documentation plan.

issues.title: Development and Debugging Tools
issues.description: Lack of specialized tools for debugging data flow and actions in JSON UI.
manifestations: Debugging requires manual analysis of logs and storage states.
improvementPlan: Research and development of tools for visualizing state and data flow.
